agent: reader C of the moving wave (the division need's arithmetic)
question: What CAIUnit::EstimateAreaNeed and CAIUnit::EstimateTheatreNeed compute - the division need and their_power - exactly, so that it can be computed from a save; what France's 0.5% in our_power is; and how a power under 1.000 passed the whole-number gate on its first post.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::EstimateAreaNeed
addresses.signature: int __thiscall CAIUnit::EstimateAreaNeed(CAIUnit* this, COwnerArea* region, int* theirPowerOut, CList* visited, bool relaxed)
addresses.comment: **The divisions one owner area needs, and the only place their_power is computed.** Read whole on the listing, rva 0x4B82F0 to the `ret 0x10` at 0x4B9488 (three exits). C = the agent's country (+0x34), R = region. (0) If CCountry::IsEnemy(C, R's first province's controller, that province) (0x2F210): answer CountEnemyUnitsInArea(&C.strategy, R, 0) (0x4A8EF0) - no power, no recursion, no floor. (1) If C is ITA (CCountryDataBase tag_ITA) and R's first province is held by ETH (tag_ETH): answer 0. (2) objCount = the plan's objectives (CUnit +0x234) lying in R and stamped with this theatre (CMapProvince +0x380/+0x384 against GetArea's id; with no theatre, lying in the plan's ops area +0x214); for the human's delegated AI only (CEU3AI +0x2C runs_units clear) the distinct areas of the other objectives that border R make list A. (3) For each province p of the front vector CAIUnit +0xC0 (land of front-worthy countries beside the ops area, FINDINGS-opsarea.md) whose area is real: p is a front of R when an edge not of kind 3 reaches a simulated province of R with MaxInfrastructure >= 200 (g_AiFrontProvinceThreshold, rva 0x17151E4); a NAP between C and p's controller younger than NAP_UNBREAKABLE_MONTHS * 2 / 3 whole calendar months unmakes it. fw = C.strategy.IsFrontWorthyEnemy(ctrl) (0x4A9390), wc = C.strategy.IsWarCandidate(ctrl) (0x4A9A30, receiver in EDI). Counted when fw (and then, when !wc and ctrl's GetSurrenderProgress / 1000.0 > 0.1, **halved**), or when !fw and p's area is in list A. anyFront is set by every counted province but a halved one. weight = relaxed && no NAP ? (wc ? 1000 : 500) : (wc ? 2000 : 1000), /2 when halved; floor = (MaxInfrastructure(p) <= 300 (rva 0x1715204) or halved) ? 500 (rva 0x1715218) : 1000. Hostile units in p: land units (slot 15) whose owner is id 0 or REB, or not CCountry::IsSameSide and either not co_belligerent (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) or CCountry::IsEnemyTag - so at peace every foreign unit not on our side, headquarters included; n of them, P = the sum of their CUnit::GetPower. score = max(floor, floorf((n + 0.0005) * 1000) * weight / 1000) = max(floor, n * weight); power = P * weight / 1000. When p lies in the area of its controller's acting capital and the controller is the first member of its (non-empty) faction: score += weight, power += power * weight / 1000. When score > 1000, C's capital area is real, is not R and borders p's area: power = power * 1000 / score, score = 1000. *theirPowerOut += power; weightSum += score; p's area joins list B. (4) Bf = the land brigades (+0x40) of each B area's controller standing in that area; Pf = B's provinces. (5) **N1 = round half to even(float(weightSum) / 1000.0)**, by fld/fistp. (6) **N2**, only when R's first province is C's: F = the float sum of CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue(p, agent, false) (0x4B9710) over the theatre's provinces (CTheatre +0x60; the plan's ops area with no theatre) lying in R; N2 = trunc(F / min(R.provinces, 40)), at most R.provinces / 4 (raised to 1 only when !relaxed); when R has no neighbouring area (+0x3C = 0) and is not C's capital area, N2 > 1 with under 3 provinces -> 1, N2 > 2 with under 15 -> 2; otherwise N2 = 1 when it is 0 and F > 2.0. (7) need = objCount + (anyFront && N2 > N1 ? N2 : N1). (8) When R's region group (+0x6C) holds more than one province (AreaGroup_CountProvinces, 0x803F0): for each focus area (CAIUnit +0x338) of the same group not on `visited`, it goes on `visited` and need += EstimateAreaNeed(it, theirPowerOut, visited, relaxed). (9) R C's, not C's capital area, COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(R) (0x7FD90) and Pf > 3: need += 4. (10) C's theatre count (+0x578) > 1 and need > 2 * Bf: need = max(need / 2, 2 * Bf), at least 1. (11) R is C's capital area and C is_major (+0x15C) or max_ic (+0x60C) > 100: need = max(need, relaxed ? max(sum of R's ports' naval base level_max / 1000, / 4, R.ports_count / 2) : 3 * R.ports_count). (12) need >= 1. (13) R not C's and not C's subject (+0xF3C): need > 1 -> max(need / 2, 1). (14) C is ITA and province 9943 (Addis Abeba) is in R, or its area borders R while its controller is ITA's subject: need /= 3, with no floor after it. Every division in C integer arithmetic (toward zero). Callers: 0x4B9155 (itself), 0x4B966C (EstimateTheatreNeed, relaxed 1), 0x4BF9F3 (the donor's area keep, relaxed 1), 0x4C453C (AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift, relaxed from BL). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.
addresses.revises: The previous comment (FINDINGS-power.md) had the score as enemyCount * weight / 1000 (it is n * weight, in thousandths), the need as weightSum / min(provinces, 40) (that division is of the province-value float sum F, a second estimate; the weight sum is rounded by fistp and not divided), 'a country-database comparison' (it is ITA against ETH), 'halved when a relation test passes' (surrender progress over 10% of a front-worthy country that is no war candidate), and missed the capital-area faction bonus, the cap near our capital, the brigade halving, the capital-area naval floor, the foreign halving, the +4 and the Addis Abeba division.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x8B82F0-0x8B9488 read instruction by instruction, x87/SSE tracked by hand (the tail VA 0x8B8F26-0x8B9098: cvtdq2ps/divsd 1000.0/fld/fistp gives N1; 0x8B8FC0-0x8B9026 the float sum of 0x8B9710 divided by min(count,40) with cvttsd2si gives N2); constants read from the image (VA 0x160A300 = 1000.0, 0x160A460 = 0.0005, 0x160A3C0 = 0.1, 0x1718064 = 2.0f). Against the saves (scratch need.py/theirscan.py, areas flooded from the save's controllers and the install's adjacencies.bin): every European Soviet theatre's need comes out 18 - the capital-area floor, 73 naval-base levels / 4 in the 2694-province Soviet area - and F.1's balancing with needs of 18 reproduces Kyiv->Arkhangelsk 5, Odessa->Arkhangelsk 6 and Arkhangelsk->Leningrad 4 exactly; their_power is reproduced exactly where a post falls inside a save window: Kwantung Army Theater 13812 at both 01_08_03 and 01_08_06 (with the Manchukuo focus areas' recursion and SOV's capital-area x1.5), Paris HQ 92 (BEL and LUX units at weight 500), Bordeaux HQ 2988; over 01_01_00-01_04_12, 72 of 106 equal one end and 10 more lie between the ends. Shown wrong by: a their_power posted inside a save window that this arithmetic cannot reach with the right front-worthy set; or Odessa->Leningrad and Odessa->Brjansk (5 and 4 in the saves, 6 and 5 by F.1 with needs of 18) proving to be the need rather than the pick.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::EstimateTheatreNeed
addresses.comment: **The division need of a theatre agent, and its their_power.** Read whole, 0x4B9610 to the `ret 4` at 0x4B9691: theatre = CAIUnit::GetArea(this) (`this` in EAX); none -> 0 and *theirPowerOut untouched. Otherwise one empty `visited` CList, and for each COwnerArea of CTheatre +0x84 in order (a null payload skipped) need += CAIUnit::EstimateAreaNeed(area, theirPowerOut, &visited, relaxed = 1); the list is freed (CList_FreeAndClear) and the sum returned. No cap of its own. `visited` is shared across the theatre's areas, so a focus area is counted once, under the first of the theatre's areas in its region group; the theatre's own areas never go on it. *theirPowerOut is only added to - the caller zeroes it. Every area that takes no early exit gives at least 1, so a theatre's need is at least the number of its areas less those held by an enemy (and, for Italy, held by Ethiopia or cut by the Addis Abeba division). Two callers: CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower (0x4B50A8) and CAIUnit_ComputePlanForcesAndPower (0x4B622B). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.
addresses.revises: Comment only: the shared visited list, the null-theatre exit, and what the sum implies; the arithmetic is EstimateAreaNeed's, now read whole.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x8B9610-0x8B9691: `push 1` at 0x8B9662 is relaxed, `lea ecx,[ebp-0x20]` the one visited list for every call, CList_FreeAndClear (VA 0x50D1E0) after the loop. Shown wrong by a second call site to EstimateAreaNeed inside this body, which there is not.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue
addresses.signature: float __stdcall CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue(CMapProvince* province@ECX, CAIUnit* agent@stack:4, bool withSupplyAndShips@stack:8) @XMM0
addresses.comment: **What one of our provinces is worth holding, as a float** - the per-province term of EstimateAreaNeed's second estimate (N2 = sum / min(provinces, 40)), and the term CAIUnit_ScoreHoldProvince (0x4B4200) adds. 0x4B9710 to the `ret 8` at 0x4B9E9F, the answer in XMM0 (both callers read xmm0 straight after the call). C = the agent's country. 0 when the province's MaxInfrastructure < 200. near = some edge not of kind 3 reaches a simulated land province whose controller K is not C.IsFriend(K, true) and has threat >= 100.0 - K's strategy threat towards C (CAIStrategy::GetThreat, 0x4A4DC0), plus C's antagonism of K (GetAntagonism, 0x4A4E00) when C is at peace (+0xACC), its CEU3AI runs_units is set and !withSupplyAndShips - or is front-worthy to C (IsFrontWorthyEnemy); the walk stops at the first. full = 1 except for USA at war while ENG owns provinces and is not in exile and USA's core VP owned minus held (+0xBE0 - +0xBE4) is under 2000. v = near ? 3 * FORT_LEVEL (modifier 10, whole levels) : 0; full and COASTAL_FORT_LEVEL cf > 0: v += 5 * (cf + 1); w = full ? air base level_max : 0, plus, full and naval base level_max n > 0: (C is GER or ITA ? x = 10n + 30, above 100 -> (x - 100) / 5 + 90 : n); w x 2.0 when the province is not in its controller's capital area and its area has under 15 provinces; v += w. Victory points vp > 0: owned by C -> v += max(2vp + 5, vp * 100.0 / (C.victory_points_owned (+0xBDC) / 1000.0)); controlled by C and owned by a country not in exile -> v += 2vp + 5. C's acting capital: +100. full and a real strategic resource (+0x18, slot 14): +60. x = province IC (modifier 15) / 1000.0 * 0.5; r = max(effective revolt risk (GetProvinceEffectiveRevoltRisk, 0xA4050), max(minimum_revolt_risk (modifier 0), 0)) / 1000.0. Without the flag v += x; with it: +100 for the province's own supply depot (+0x48 == id), v += r * x, and full with a naval base and a naval station (+0x58): v += 30 + 2 x its ships (CUnitList::GetTotalNumOfShips, 0x1D5CC0). Finally + 0.25 x the priority of the plan's objective on the province, if any. Two callers: EstimateAreaNeed (0x4B8FD2, flag 0) and CAIUnit_ScoreHoldProvince (0x4B4670, flag 1). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.
addresses.evidence: Listing VA 0x8B9710-0x8B9E9F read instruction by instruction; constants from the image (VA 0x160A358 = 100.0, 0x160A360 = 2.0, 0x160A4A8 = 60.0, 0x160A308 = 0.5, 0x160A8F0 = 30.0, 0x160A258 = 0.25); the decompiler (scratch d2.c) agrees on the structure and names the two hash lookups CAIStrategy::GetThreat and GetAntagonism (luabind). The strategic-resource slot is ReturnTrue (VA 0xA92590) on CStrategicResource and not on CNullStrategicResource. No save isolates the figure - for the Soviet theatres N2 stays under the capital floor - so a wrong term would not show there; shown wrong by a theatre whose need is set by N2 and does not match.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower
addresses.comment: **The writer of `our_power` and `their_power` for every country the AI runs.** `this->+0x35C` = 0, `this->+0x358` = CAIUnit_SumOurPower(this, &+0x35C); `this->+0x360` = 0, `this->+0x354` = CAIUnit::EstimateTheatreNeed(this, &+0x360); then posts `CSetPlanAttributesCommand(unit, 5, 3, 3, +0x35C, +0x360)` - powers only - **only when the whole part of either figure differs from the plan's**: `plan.our_power / 1000 != new / 1000 || plan.their_power / 1000 != new / 1000`, C integer division (0x4B50BC-0x4B5115). It is not 'more than a thousandth': a plan holding 0.524 keeps it while the estimate stays under 1.000. **How a figure under 1.000 gets its first post (inferred):** before the agent's first pass the theatre's plan is inactive, and CUnit::UpdateDaily (call at 0x1BB326) calls CUnit::UpdatePlanForceNeeds with a null fifth argument for every oob_level-0 unit; on an inactive plan that writes the plan's own min, our_power and their_power directly, with no command (0x1BD498-0x1BD4C4), from ComputePlanWantedSubUnits (0x4E1D00) - our = the whole order of battle, headquarters brigades included, each brigade (strength / max strength) x (organisation / max organisation) x its combat value, their = the raw combat value of the unfriendly regiments beside the plan's area. A theatre headquarters brigade alone (1.33 for an hq_brigade) puts that our_power at 1 or more, so the first UpdatePlanPower finds a different whole number and posts the small figure. Two callers: CAIUnit::SetUnit (slot 63) at 0x4BA02E, right after it posts the activation and runs slot 78, and 0x48E490 at 0x48E553, which ProcessAI runs at the country's hour `id % 24` (when 0x48DCF0 answers false and CEU3AI +0xA5 is set) for every agent whose root theatre resolves. So for an AI country the plan's powers move only when a whole number is crossed, at most once a day. **our_power reproduces exactly** once each technology level's toughness effect is counted twice in the regiment's definition (CSubUnitDefinition::Add, FINDINGS-unitdef.md): France's Paris HQ 15.017 and Bordeaux HQ 17.167, posted between the 8 January 06:00 and 07:00 saves, which the plain sum put 0.5% low. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds how a sub-1.000 figure passes the gate on its first post (the inactive plan's powers are written daily by UpdatePlanForceNeeds' null-argument arm) and the exact reproduction of France's two posts with toughness counted twice - the 0.5% of FINDINGS-agents.md D.4.
addresses.evidence: Gate re-read at VA 0x8B50B3-0x8B5115. The direct write: CUnit::UpdatePlanForceNeeds at VA 0x5BD498-0x5BD4C4 zeroes [plan+0x84] and [plan+0x80] and passes their addresses as ComputePlanWantedSubUnits' ownStrength/areaStrength, on the arm taken when the fifth argument is null; UpdateDaily's call at VA 0x5BB317-0x5BB326 pushes 0 for it; the arm is skipped only when the top unit's plan is active (+0x204) at oob_level 0. ownStrength's formula from the decompiler (scratch d1.c) - inferred. France: scratch posted.py/ourpower2.py, SumOurPower over 01_08_06 and 01_08_07 gives 14946/17106 plainly and 15017/17167 with toughness doubled, the posted figures exactly; Kwantung's 40084, posted between 01_08_03 and 01_08_06, is reproduced either way. Shown wrong by an AI theatre whose first posted our_power is under 1.000 while its ownStrength is too.

struct_fields.name: neighbour_areas_last
struct_fields.comment: Tail of the neighbour-link CList at +0x34 (count +0x3C), written by COwnerArea::AdjustNeighbour (0x7EAD0) when it appends a link. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.

struct_fields.name: victory_points_owned
struct_fields.comment: Victory points in thousandths, summed over every province the country owns (+0xCF0): zeroed with +0xBE0/+0xBE4 and `prov->victory_points * 1000` added in CCountry::RebuildNeighbours (0xE21E0; VA 0x4E2305 and 0x4E2A35). CAIUnit_ProvinceHoldValue divides a province's points by it (as a float over 1000) for its share in percent. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section C.
struct_fields.evidence: Listing VA 0x4E29B9-0x4E2A35: the walk of the owned list +0xCF0 and the add to [ebx+0xBDC]; the zeroing at 0x4E2305. Shown wrong by another writer of +0xBDC on a CCountry.
